authority: The later direct framework-setup request supersedes earlier blanket design-only labels for that scope. Current finalization makes documentation/tracking changes only. Specific library/policy acceptance and live effects are not inferred.

historical_baseline.role: byte-identical historical provenance; not active configuration

supersession.legacy_implementation_authorized_false: historical phase, not current blanket authority

decisions.recommendation: One native C/C++ application machine; orchestration hosts and narrow lifecycle/physical providers, not private user/billing/knowledge services.
decisions.qualification: Actual program closure and process/host grants; account and billing data follow native source/reference/effect laws.

decisions.recommendation: Retain researched React/TypeScript/Vite and Node-LTS build candidates; static client workspace, not a second semantic Node backend.
decisions.qualification: Exact patched/transitive artifacts, licenses and approved frontend profile; historical release observations are not locks.

decisions.recommendation: React Aria/headless table candidates render native-selected results through one schema/query/selection model.
decisions.qualification: Current adapter APIs, exact values, virtualized keyboard behavior, compatible renderers and visual layouts.

decisions.recommendation: ASP.NET Core/.NET10 BFF with reviewed external-protocol handlers and generated native/API marshaling.
decisions.qualification: Exact SDK/Npgsql/native ABI profile; no CLR/ORM person or entitlement semantics.

decisions.recommendation: Retain repository product PostgreSQL/native package; independent operational durability, with control PostgreSQL as a candidate. Broker storage exists only if a broker is actually selected.
decisions.qualification: Account/path/capacity migration, native recovery grant and revocation behavior; same-host separation does not survive host loss.

decisions.recommendation: Direct configured Microsoft/Google login through standard handlers; no B2C/customer directory or mandatory Keycloak. Provider assertions feed native source/reference/authority programs. Optional broker/authorization server is selected only for an actual protocol need.
decisions.qualification: Operator application registration/redirects/protected credentials; account audience and linking; distinct qualified API/MCP resource-token issuer profile. Missing credentials do not block framework setup.

decisions.recommendation: Protected server-held credentials/session tickets and purpose-bound keys outside product-reset scope, with native grants and current revocation.
decisions.qualification: Session lifetime, CSRF/issuer/audience/callback profile, recovery and offline policy; decryption or login alone grants no permission.

decisions.recommendation: Retain maintained Caddy candidate with explicit HTTPS, static assets, trusted forwarded headers and route-specific streaming/cancellation.
decisions.qualification: Actual origin/certificates, exact proxy artifact and end-to-end cancellation; no implicit broker route and no blind mutation replay.

decisions.recommendation: Native-registry-generated API schemas and typed bulk codec; preserve researched OpenAPI3.1/JSON-Schema2020-12 candidate profile.
decisions.qualification: Exact fields/route/error/binary/version map, numeric fidelity, caller scope and variable output ownership; no pointer serialization or duplicate canonical codec.

decisions.recommendation: Native durable operation lifecycle, journal/outbox and commit-ordered publication; notification is a wakeup, request streams and durable jobs are distinct.
decisions.qualification: Per-stream frontier, cross-store effects, bounded slow-consumer recovery, pinned MCP profile and cancellation; no generic exactly-once promise.

decisions.recommendation: Qualified shared C/C++ worker/Wasm target with generated batch/handle/buffer/need-resume bridge; server-only PG work remains on the PG host.
decisions.qualification: Actual libraries, compiler, numeric profile, worker lifetime/resources and threaded/nonthreaded bundles; no JS replacement or silent private-input upload.

decisions.recommendation: IndexedDB transactional record/owned-state/outbox candidate; OPFS initially rebuildable or recoverable packs; explicit coordinated writers.
decisions.qualification: Atomic publication boundaries, quota/persistence failure, account isolation and export/recovery; no IDB/OPFS joint ACID assumption.

decisions.recommendation: Retain exact content/physicality/label bodies, separately synchronize active heads and collection membership, stage compatible runtime/descriptor/perfcache generations.
decisions.qualification: Newly matching records and preferred labels update; owned state survives upgrades; exact body reuse does not make query answers permanent.

decisions.recommendation: Bounded Npgsql/set-wise native access with summed pool/worker allocation from the existing resource grant.
decisions.qualification: Measure actual host capacity and status/cancel reserve; repository maximum24 is not a separate entitlement for each process.

decisions.recommendation: Retain researched ASVS mapping and restricted host/import/egress boundaries under current native authority.
decisions.qualification: Actual threats/control IDs/sandbox profiles and fixtures; signatures, LAN location and content hashes alone confer neither safety nor authority.

decisions.recommendation: Separate product/control/keys/local-owned-state recovery, qualified off-host backup/WAL/PITR profile, actual isolated restore/readback.
decisions.qualification: Provider, schedules/capacity and measured RPO/RTO; optional broker backup only if deployed; old backups cannot revive surviving revoked authority.

decisions.recommendation: Retain immutable native/service delivery and explicitly qualified optional container profiles with staged activation/rollback.
decisions.qualification: Actual account/path/package/schema/reader/draft handoff; framework setup does not authorize a live deployment or reset.

decisions.recommendation: Native measurements plus protected structured logs and optional OpenTelemetry; built-in admin history does not depend on an external dashboard.
decisions.qualification: Actual native/client/BFF/PG trace chain and first usable labelled response; no secret/high-cardinality metric leakage or sampled-trace-as-audit.

decisions.recommendation: Locked artifacts, license/SBOM and provenance, isolated build identities, reviewed promotion and rollback.
decisions.qualification: Exact workflow/dependency hashes, builder/trust roots and deployed evidence; no untrusted PR with live secrets and no certification from prose.

decisions.recommendation: Typed source/native-operation/renderer/layout packages over the common workspace. OAuth, billing, games and other application data use the same native model.
decisions.qualification: Actual unfamiliar-domain and target fixtures; one-day integration is prerequisite-bound and unmeasured; no provider/domain-specific application engine.

implementation_packets.output: locked release/target profile and actual native dependency map
process/account/path/socket/capacity and recovery specification without mandatory broker
shared control bindings, annotated task layouts and meaningful response fixtures
direct provider account assertions, native linking/grants, credential recovery and API/MCP issuer profile
native intake/journal/effect reconciliation, exact event ordering and backup/cutover
artifact promotion and complete installed browser/provider/native evidence

open_decisions.decision: Ratify specific physical technology and visual choices; framework setup itself has already been requested.
Exact patched/transitive artifacts, compiler/ABI and variable-result/native program closure.
Actual hostname/trust, provider app registrations, protected credential destination, host accounts and capacity.
Role/enrollment, resource/retention, local-key recovery, RPO/RTO and offline disclosure policy.
Qualified resource-token issuer and exact API/MCP client profile, separate from direct login; optional broker only where selected.
Annotated visual layouts, unfamiliar-domain fixtures, actual platform/numerical/latency qualification.

research_limitations: Prior dated version observations were not requalified as a complete artifact set during finalization.
No application/native build or runtime test, live database query, provider registration, payment or deployment performed.
Prior SQLite-Wasm persistence and systemd man-page retrieval limitations remain in the original research ledger.
Container public-GitHub download failed DNS during finalization; GitHub connector reads/writes are the preservation path. No full local clone or hart-server worktree audit is claimed.
